_note: English questions were written by the team (2026-09-21) and shortened on 2026-09-22: one question per breath, since each is read aloud to someone whose English may be limited. The contacts question was dropped because /start already collects the phone and email. The zh versions were drafted by Claude and have not yet been checked by a native speaker; Tommy to review.

questions.en: Tell me a little about yourself, and what work you hope to find here.
questions.zh: 请简单介绍一下你自己，还有你希望在这里找什么工作。

questions.en: Where did you study, and what did you study there?
questions.zh: 你在哪里读书？学的是什么？

questions.en: What was your last job, and what did you do each day?
questions.zh: 你最近一份工作是做什么的？每天做哪些事？

questions.en: Have you done any unpaid work, or helped your community?
questions.zh: 你做过无偿的工作，或者帮助过你的社区吗？

questions.en: What are you good at? Tools, machines, computers, languages — anything.
questions.zh: 你擅长什么？工具、机器、电脑、语言，什么都可以。

questions.en: Do you have any certificates, licences, or training records?
questions.zh: 你有证书、执照，或者培训记录吗？
